entries.title: Tom Clancy's The Division
entries.definitive_edition: Tom Clancy's The Division - Definitive Edition on PC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC Definitive Edition while official servers remain available

primary.version: Tom Clancy's The Division - Definitive Edition
primary.why: Ubisoft's current Definitive Edition bundles the base game, all three Season Pass expansions, and cosmetic packs. PC is the cleanest capture route, but the game remains online-only and requires documenting live-service/server state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Definitive Edition on PC/Ubisoft Connect or Steam. Record edition, server state, character/build, World Tier, Dark Zone state, Underground/Survival/Last Stand access, matchmaking population, and online-only dependency.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2026 Definitive Edition is a complete bundle, not a full remake. Record online-only status and matchmaking/service state.
